item.title: Virginia cracks down on electricity firms hiking prices for AI data centers — move could save ‘hundreds of millions of dollars’ for everyday users

item.title: Why are brands suddenly all about wicker on social media?
item.description: The trailer for the forthcoming movie ‘Wicker’ has brands leaning into social media users’ newfound prurient interest in the material. It’s never been a better time to be in the wicker business. Brands are leaning into the woven art form as a forthcoming movie has people asking “What if a basket could be a sexy man?”

item.title: 3D-printed drones built on a US Navy ship for the first time, potentially opening a whole new world of possibilities for future warfare
item.description: Firestorm Labs manufactured 12 drones aboard USS Essex using a containerized 3D-printing factory during its voyage toward RIMPAC 2026.

item.title: Now Rippling is counter-suing tiny startup Runlayer
item.description: This lawsuit follows one filed last month by Runlayer that accused Rippling of stealing its product ideas. It's a seller- and buyer-beware market warning.
